full_judgment: 2. One Fulbash Bibi, the predecessor of respondent Nos. 4-7, intending to transfer her land to the appellant and another executed a deed of Hibabil Ewaj in their favour on December 20, 1971. The deed was presented for registration on March 27, 1972. In the meantime, however, Fulbash Bibi died in the end of December, 1971. The District Registrar refused registration of the deed without assigning any reason for his refusal. The appellant along with another filed O.C. Suit No. 101 of 1972 against respondent Nos. 4-7, heirs of Fulbash Bibi, under section 77 of the Registration Act. The suit was decreed ex-parte on December 31, 1973, declaring that the plaintiffs were entitled to get the deed registered if the same was not otherwise defective and barred. On January 29, 1974 the deed along with the certified copies of the judgment and decree of O.C. Suit No. 101 of 1972 of the court of Munsif, Rajshahi was presented for registration. The deed was returned with the endorsement in the first page of the deed that an affidavit under the provisions of President's Order No. 142 of 1972 was required. Thereupon the appellant submitted another application to the District Registrar, Rajshahi on May 5, 1977 for registration of the deed, who instead of registering it, sought for instructions from the Inspector-General of Registration on July 24, 1978. The appellant submitted an application to the Inspector-General for giving permission to register the deed on August 28, 1978. The prayer for registration was refused by the Assistant Inspector-General of Registration. The appellant moved the High Court Division under Article 102 of the Constitution. The learned Judges of the High Court Division held that in view of the appellant's failure to show that the deed was presented for registration within time, the registration was barred under section 77 of the Registration Act. The Assistant Inspector-General of Registration did not, therefore, commit any illegality. Further, the appellant did not sufficiently explain the reasons for the unusual delay in filing the writ petition. It was summarily rejected.
